65f689.reasoning: sc_notify_payload_nbx (src/sc_notify.c:1896) posts Issends with tag SC_TAG_NOTIFY_NBX, polls MPI_Iprobe(ANY_SOURCE) at line 1963 and receives from the probed source. A rank enters MPI_Ibarrier only after all its synchronous sends are matched, so when the Ibarrier completes every call-0 message has been received. The classic NBX hazard (a fast rank starting call 1 and its message being probed by a slower rank still in call 0's loop) is closed by the blocking MPI_Barrier after the loop: no rank can post call-1 Issends until every rank has left call 0's polling loop. Receivers are uniqued, so each source sends at most one message per call, and the Recv after the probe takes the probed message. The 4-byte payload is under the 1024-byte eager threshold, so the second payload phase is not used. Synchronous sends make the result independent of buffering.
